verdict.rationale: Modal's official GitHub repo documents a first-party Python SDK for deploying serverless apps and interacting with the platform programmatically, plus official JS and Go SDKs. The JS and Go SDKs are scoped to Sandboxes, invoking deployed Functions, and only some platform resources. missing for 10: feature parity in the JS/Go SDKs, in-depth SDK reference documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
The JS and Go SDKs allow you to use Modal Sandboxes, invoke deployed Modal Functions, and interact with some Modal platform resources.
